import layout = "./layout.qui"

class Requirement(int point, string position)
class PointLock(int route, string position)
class Route(string name, int start, string finish_name, string finish_kind, int finish_index, Requirement[] requirements, int[] sections, int[] overlap, string[] conflict_names, int approach_time, string direction)
    int[] conflicts := []
    state := "none"
    release_time := -1
    passed := distinct<int>()
    overlap_locked := false
    overlap_counter := 0
    requests := 0
    grants := 0
    uses := 0
    cancels := 0
    wait := 0
    maxwait := 0
    locked_seconds := 0

class State(Route[] routes, map<string, int> route_ids, int[] route_locks, int[][] overlap_locks, PointLock[][] point_locks)

string[] name_list(string text)
    return if text == "-" then [] else text.split(",")

Requirement[] parse_requirements(string text, layout.Network network)
    Requirement[] result := []
    for item := name_list(text)[]
        pieces := item.split(":")
        result = result.append(Requirement(layout.lookup_index(network.point_ids, pieces[0]), pieces[1]))
    return result

State read_routes(layout.Network network)
    Route[] routes := []
    map<string, int> ids
    for row := layout.read_lines("routes.txt")[]
        fields := row.split(" ")
        start := layout.lookup_index(network.signal_ids, fields[2])
        finish_kind := "boundary"
        finish_index := layout.lookup_index(network.boundary_ids, fields[3])
        if network.signal_ids.has(fields[3])
            finish_kind = "signal"
            finish_index = layout.lookup_index(network.signal_ids, fields[3])
        elif network.buffer_ids.has(fields[3])
            finish_kind = "buffer"
            finish_index = layout.lookup_index(network.buffer_ids, fields[3])
        Requirement[] requirements := parse_requirements(fields[4], network).concat(parse_requirements(fields[7], network))
        sections := [for name := name_list(fields[5])[] then layout.lookup_index(network.section_ids, name)]
        overlap := [for name := name_list(fields[6])[] then layout.lookup_index(network.section_ids, name)]
        .ids.set(fields[1], int(#routes))
        routes = routes.append(Route(fields[1], start, fields[3], finish_kind, finish_index, requirements, sections, overlap, name_list(fields[8]), int(fields[9]), network.signals[start].direction))
    for: i < int(#routes)
        routes[i].conflicts = [for name := routes[i].conflict_names[] then layout.lookup_index(ids, name)]
    route_locks := array(#network.sections, fill = -1)
    int[][] overlap_locks := []
    for: i < int(#network.sections)
        overlap_locks = overlap_locks.append([])
    PointLock[][] point_locks := []
    for: i < int(#network.points)
        point_locks = point_locks.append([])
    return State(routes, ids, route_locks, overlap_locks, point_locks)

void lock_route(State &state, int route_index)
    &route := &state.routes[route_index]
    route.state = "LOCKED"
    route.release_time = -1
    route.passed = distinct<int>()
    route.overlap_locked = true
    route.overlap_counter = 0
    for section := route.sections[]
        state.route_locks[section] = route_index
    for section := route.overlap[]
        state.overlap_locks[section] = state.overlap_locks[section].append(route_index)
    for requirement := route.requirements[]
        exists := false
        for held := state.point_locks[requirement.point][]
            if held.route == route_index and held.position == requirement.position
                exists = true
        if not exists
            state.point_locks[requirement.point] = state.point_locks[requirement.point].append(PointLock(route_index, requirement.position))

void unlock_points(State &state, layout.Network network, int route_index, int[] sections, all_points := false)
    for: p < int(#network.points)
        selected := all_points
        for section := sections[]
            if network.points[p].common == section
                selected = true
        if selected
            state.point_locks[p] = [for held := state.point_locks[p][] if held.route != route_index then held]

void unlock_section(State &state, layout.Network network, int route_index, int section)
    if state.route_locks[section] == route_index
        state.route_locks[section] = -1
    unlock_points(&state, network, route_index, [section])

void unlock_overlap(State &state, layout.Network network, int route_index)
    sections := state.routes[route_index].overlap
    for section := sections[]
        state.overlap_locks[section] = [for held := state.overlap_locks[section][] if held != route_index then held]
    unlock_points(&state, network, route_index, sections)
    state.routes[route_index].overlap_locked = false

void release_route(State &state, layout.Network network, int route_index)
    for section := state.routes[route_index].sections[]
        if state.route_locks[section] == route_index
            state.route_locks[section] = -1
    if state.routes[route_index].overlap_locked
        unlock_overlap(&state, network, route_index)
    unlock_points(&state, network, route_index, [], true)
    state.routes[route_index].state = "none"
    state.routes[route_index].release_time = -1

class Section(string name, int length, int row, int first, int last)
    failed := false
    int[] occupants := []
    occupied_seconds := 0
    locked_seconds := 0
    trains := distinct<int>()

class Point(string name, string side, int common, int normal, int reverse, int row, int column)
    position := "N"
    moving := false
    failed := false
    target := "N"
    completion := -1
    throws := 0
    locked_seconds := 0
    moving_seconds := 0

class Signal(string name, int section, string direction, int row, int column)
    aspect := "RED"
    seconds := [0, 0, 0]
    passes := 0

class Endpoint(string name, int section, string end, row := 0, column := 0)
class Label(int row, int column, string text)
class Connection(string kind, int index)

class Network()
    Section[] sections := []
    Point[] points := []
    Signal[] signals := []
    Endpoint[] buffers := []
    Endpoint[] boundaries := []
    Label[] labels := []
    Connection[][] ends := []
    section_ids := map<string, int>()
    point_ids := map<string, int>()
    signal_ids := map<string, int>()
    buffer_ids := map<string, int>()
    boundary_ids := map<string, int>()

int lookup_index(map<string, int> ids, string name)
    match ids.get(name)
        int index
            return index
        none
            return -1

string[] read_lines(string filename)
    string content := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/" + filename))
    rows := content.split(NL)
    return rows[0:<int(#rows) - 1]

Network read_layout()
    result := Network()
    for row := read_lines("layout.txt")[]
        fields := row.split(" ")
        kind := fields[0]
        if kind == "SECTION"
            index := int(#result.sections)
            .result.section_ids.set(fields[1], index)
            result.sections = result.sections.append(Section(fields[1], int(fields[2]), int(fields[3]), int(fields[4]), int(fields[5])))
            result.ends = result.ends.append([Connection("", -1), Connection("", -1)])
        elif kind == "JOINT"
            first := lookup_index(result.section_ids, fields[1])
            second := lookup_index(result.section_ids, fields[2])
            result.ends[first][1] = Connection("section", second)
            result.ends[second][0] = Connection("section", first)
        elif kind == "POINT"
            index := int(#result.points)
            .result.point_ids.set(fields[1], index)
            common := lookup_index(result.section_ids, fields[3])
            normal := lookup_index(result.section_ids, fields[4])
            reverse := lookup_index(result.section_ids, fields[5])
            result.points = result.points.append(Point(fields[1], fields[2], common, normal, reverse, int(fields[6]), int(fields[7])))
            side := if fields[2] == "R" then 1 else 0
            result.ends[common][side] = Connection("point", index)
            result.ends[normal][1 - side] = Connection("point", index)
            result.ends[reverse][1 - side] = Connection("point", index)
        elif kind == "SIGNAL"
            .result.signal_ids.set(fields[1], int(#result.signals))
            result.signals = result.signals.append(Signal(fields[1], lookup_index(result.section_ids, fields[2]), fields[3], int(fields[4]), int(fields[5])))
        elif kind == "BUFFER" or kind == "BOUNDARY"
            section := lookup_index(result.section_ids, fields[2])
            side := if fields[3] == "R" then 1 else 0
            if kind == "BUFFER"
                index := int(#result.buffers)
                .result.buffer_ids.set(fields[1], index)
                result.buffers = result.buffers.append(Endpoint(fields[1], section, fields[3], int(fields[4]), int(fields[5])))
                result.ends[section][side] = Connection("buffer", index)
            else
                index := int(#result.boundaries)
                .result.boundary_ids.set(fields[1], index)
                result.boundaries = result.boundaries.append(Endpoint(fields[1], section, fields[3]))
                result.ends[section][side] = Connection("boundary", index)
        else
            result.labels = result.labels.append(Label(int(fields[1]), int(fields[2]), fields[3]))
    return result

Connection beyond_end(Network network, int section, string direction)
    connection := network.ends[section][if direction == "UP" then 1 else 0]
    if connection.kind != "point"
        return connection
    point := network.points[connection.index]
    branch := if point.position == "N" then point.normal else point.reverse
    if point.moving or (section != point.common and section != branch)
        return Connection("impassable", -1)
    return Connection("section", if section == point.common then branch else point.common)

int signal_at(Network network, int section, string direction)
    for: i < int(#network.signals)
        if network.signals[i].section == section and network.signals[i].direction == direction
            return i
    return -1

bool track_occupied(Network network, int section)
    return network.sections[section].failed or #network.sections[section].occupants > 0

import layout = "./layout.qui"
import interlocking = "./interlocking.qui"
import signals = "./signals.qui"
import trains = "./trains.qui"
import safety = "./safety.qui"

class Event(int tick, string command, string[] arguments)
class Request(int number, int route, int tick, reason := "none")
class Timing(string train_name, string location, int scheduled, int actual)
class Parameters(int end, int throw_time, int overlap_time, int[] snapshots)

Parameters read_parameters()
    rows := layout.read_lines("params.txt")
    snapshots := rows[3].split(" ")
    int[] times := []
    for: 1 <= i < int(#snapshots)
        times = times.append(int(snapshots[i]))
    return Parameters(int(rows[0].split(" ")[1]), int(rows[1].split(" ")[1]), int(rows[2].split(" ")[1]), times)

Event[] read_events()
    Event[] result := []
    for row := layout.read_lines("events.txt")[]
        fields := row.split(" ")
        result = result.append(Event(int(fields[0]), fields[1], fields[2:]))
    return result

class Simulation(layout.Network network, interlocking.State locking, trains.Plans plans, Parameters params, Event[] events)
    trains.Train[] items := plans.trains
    tick := 0
    request_count := 0
    dropped := 0
    Request[] queue := []
    string[] log_lines := []
    string[] snapshots := []
    safety_record := safety.Record()

void append_log(Simulation &sim, string content)
    sim.log_lines = sim.log_lines.append("{sim.tick} {content}")

void start_throw(Simulation &sim, int point_index, string target)
    &point := &sim.network.points[point_index]
    point.moving = true
    point.target = target
    point.completion = sim.tick + sim.params.throw_time
    append_log(&sim, "MOVE {point.name} {target} until {point.completion}")

void complete_throws(Simulation &sim)
    for: p < int(#sim.network.points)
        &point := &sim.network.points[p]
        if point.moving and point.completion == sim.tick
            point.position = point.target
            point.moving = false
            point.completion = -1
            point.throws += 1
            append_log(&sim, "POINT {point.name} {point.position}")

void release_approaches(Simulation &sim)
    for: r < int(#sim.locking.routes)
        if sim.locking.routes[r].state == "APPROACH" and sim.locking.routes[r].release_time == sim.tick
            interlocking.release_route(&sim.locking, sim.network, r)
            append_log(&sim, "TIMEOUT " + sim.locking.routes[r].name)

void add_request(Simulation &sim, int route_index, string requester)
    sim.request_count += 1
    sim.queue = sim.queue.append(Request(sim.request_count, route_index, sim.tick))
    sim.locking.routes[route_index].requests += 1
    append_log(&sim, "REQUEST q{sim.request_count} {sim.locking.routes[route_index].name} {requester}")

void cancel_route(Simulation &sim, int route_index)
    removed := false
    Request[] retained := []
    string name := sim.locking.routes[route_index].name
    for request := sim.queue[]
        if request.route == route_index
            removed = true
            sim.dropped += 1
            append_log(&sim, "DROP q{request.number} {name}")
        else
            retained = retained.append(request)
    if removed
        sim.queue = retained
        return
    &route := &sim.locking.routes[route_index]
    if route.state == "LOCKED"
        route.cancels += 1
        layout.Signal signal := sim.network.signals[route.start]
        if signal.aspect != "RED" and layout.track_occupied(sim.network, signal.section)
            route.state = "APPROACH"
            route.release_time = sim.tick + route.approach_time
            append_log(&sim, "CANCEL {name} approach until {route.release_time}")
        else
            interlocking.release_route(&sim.locking, sim.network, route_index)
            append_log(&sim, "CANCEL {name} released")
    else
        append_log(&sim, "CANCEL {name} " + (if route.state == "none" then "none" else "refused"))

void individual_throw(Simulation &sim, int point_index, string target)
    layout.Point point := sim.network.points[point_index]
    string result
    if #sim.locking.point_locks[point_index] > 0
        result = "locked"
    elif point.failed
        result = "failed"
    elif point.moving
        result = "moving"
    elif layout.track_occupied(sim.network, point.common)
        result = "occupied"
    elif point.position == target
        result = "none"
    else
        result = "start"
    append_log(&sim, "THROW {point.name} {target} {result}")
    if result == "start"
        start_throw(&sim, point_index, target)

void execute_events(Simulation &sim)
    for event := sim.events[]
        if event.tick != sim.tick
            continue
        command := event.command
        name := event.arguments[0]
        if command == "REQUEST"
            add_request(&sim, layout.lookup_index(sim.locking.route_ids, name), "OPERATOR")
        elif command == "CANCEL"
            cancel_route(&sim, layout.lookup_index(sim.locking.route_ids, name))
        elif command == "THROW"
            individual_throw(&sim, layout.lookup_index(sim.network.point_ids, name), event.arguments[1])
        elif command == "TCFAIL" or command == "TCFIX"
            section := layout.lookup_index(sim.network.section_ids, name)
            sim.network.sections[section].failed = command == "TCFAIL"
            append_log(&sim, command + " " + name)
        else
            p := layout.lookup_index(sim.network.point_ids, name)
            &point := &sim.network.points[p]
            point.failed = command == "POINTFAIL"
            if point.failed and point.moving
                point.completion = -1
            append_log(&sim, command + " " + name)
            if not point.failed and point.moving
                start_throw(&sim, p, point.target)

bool has_opposite_lock(interlocking.State state, int[] owners, string direction)
    for owner := owners[]
        if state.routes[owner].direction != direction
            return true
    return false

string request_reason(Simulation sim, int route_index)
    interlocking.Route route := sim.locking.routes[route_index]
    if route.state != "none"
        return "busy"
    for other := route.conflicts[]
        string state := sim.locking.routes[other].state
        if state == "LOCKED" or state == "APPROACH"
            return "conflict " + sim.locking.routes[other].name
    for section := route.sections[]
        string name := sim.network.sections[section].name
        if layout.track_occupied(sim.network, section)
            return "occupied " + name
        if sim.locking.route_locks[section] >= 0 or has_opposite_lock(sim.locking, sim.locking.overlap_locks[section], route.direction)
            return "locked " + name
    for section := route.overlap[]
        string name := sim.network.sections[section].name
        if layout.track_occupied(sim.network, section)
            return "occupied " + name
        owners := sim.locking.overlap_locks[section]
        if sim.locking.route_locks[section] >= 0
            owners = owners.append(sim.locking.route_locks[section])
        if has_opposite_lock(sim.locking, owners, route.direction)
            return "locked " + name
    for requirement := route.requirements[]
        layout.Point point := sim.network.points[requirement.point]
        for held := sim.locking.point_locks[requirement.point][]
            if held.position != requirement.position
                return "point {point.name} locked"
        if (not point.moving and point.position == requirement.position) or (point.moving and point.target == requirement.position)
            continue
        if point.failed
            return "point {point.name} failed"
        if point.moving
            return "point {point.name} moving"
        if layout.track_occupied(sim.network, point.common)
            return "point {point.name} occupied"
    return ""

void judge_requests(Simulation &sim)
    Request[] retained := []
    for original := sim.queue[]
        request := original
        r := request.route
        string name := sim.locking.routes[r].name
        reason := request_reason(sim, r)
        if reason != ""
            if reason != request.reason
                append_log(&sim, "WAIT q{request.number} {name} {reason}")
                request.reason = reason
            retained = retained.append(request)
            continue
        interlocking.lock_route(&sim.locking, r)
        delay := sim.tick - request.tick
        append_log(&sim, "GRANT q{request.number} {name} wait {delay}")
        sim.locking.routes[r].grants += 1
        sim.locking.routes[r].wait += delay
        if delay > sim.locking.routes[r].maxwait
            sim.locking.routes[r].maxwait = delay
        for requirement := sim.locking.routes[r].requirements[]
            layout.Point point := sim.network.points[requirement.point]
            if not point.moving and point.position != requirement.position
                start_throw(&sim, requirement.point, requirement.position)
    sim.queue = retained

void decide_signals(Simulation &sim)
    decided := signals.decide_aspects(sim.network, sim.locking)
    for: i < int(#decided)
        if sim.network.signals[i].aspect != decided[i]
            sim.network.signals[i].aspect = decided[i]
            append_log(&sim, "SIGNAL {sim.network.signals[i].name} {decided[i]}")

trains.BodyPart[] occupied_parts(layout.Network network, trains.Train train)
    trains.BodyPart[] result := []
    if train.state != "RUNNING"
        return result
    tail := train.head - train.length
    for part := train.path[]
        int end := part.start + network.sections[part.section].length
        if part.start < train.head and end > tail
            int low := if tail > part.start then tail else part.start
            high := if train.head < end then train.head else end
            result = result.append(trains.BodyPart(part.section, part.start, low, high))
    return result

trains.PathSection head_section(trains.Train train)
    for: int(#train.path) > i >= 0
        if train.path[i].start < train.head
            return train.path[i]
    return train.path[0]

bool enter_train(Simulation &sim, int train_index, distinct<int> &entered_boundaries)
    &train := &sim.items[train_index]
    if train.state == "EXITED"
        return false
    if train.state == "RUNNING"
        return true
    layout.Endpoint boundary := sim.network.boundaries[train.entry]
    if sim.tick < train.entry_time or layout.track_occupied(sim.network, boundary.section) or entered_boundaries.has(train.entry)
        return false
    train.state = "RUNNING"
    train.direction = if boundary.end == "L" then "UP" else "DOWN"
    train.path = [trains.PathSection(boundary.section, 0)]
    train.head = 0
    train.speed = train.entry_speed
    train.entered = sim.tick
    .entered_boundaries.add(train.entry)
    append_log(&sim, "ENTER {train.name} {boundary.name}")
    return true

void reverse_train(Simulation &sim, int train_index, int stop_section)
    &train := &sim.items[train_index]
    head := head_section(train)
    int end := head.start + sim.network.sections[head.section].length
    parts := occupied_parts(sim.network, train)
    trains.PathSection[] path := []
    for: int(#parts) > int i >= 0
        part := parts[i]
        int start := end - (part.start + sim.network.sections[part.section].length)
        path = path.append(trains.PathSection(part.section, start))
    train.path = path
    train.head = end - (train.head - train.length)
    train.direction = if train.direction == "UP" then "DOWN" else "UP"
    append_log(&sim, "REVERSE {train.name} {sim.network.sections[stop_section].name}")

bool finish_dwell(Simulation &sim, int train_index)
    &train := &sim.items[train_index]
    if not train.dwelling
        return true
    trains.Stop stop := train.stops[train.stop_index]
    if sim.tick < stop.arrival + stop.dwell or sim.tick < stop.scheduled_departure
        return false
    train.dwelling = false
    train.awaiting_departure = train.stop_index
    train.stop_index += 1
    if stop.kind == "TURN"
        reverse_train(&sim, train_index, stop.section)
    return true

int limit_distance(Simulation sim, trains.Train train)
    if train.boundary >= 0
        return -1
    head := head_section(train)
    section := head.section
    int distance := head.start + sim.network.sections[section].length - train.head
    while true
        signal_index := layout.signal_at(sim.network, section, train.direction)
        if signal_index >= 0 and sim.network.signals[signal_index].aspect == "RED"
            return distance
        if train.stop_index < int(#train.stops) and train.stops[train.stop_index].section == section
            return distance
        connection := layout.beyond_end(sim.network, section, train.direction)
        if connection.kind == "boundary"
            return -1
        if connection.kind == "buffer" or connection.kind == "impassable"
            return distance
        section = connection.index
        distance += sim.network.sections[section].length
    return -1

void pass_signal(Simulation &sim, int train_index, int signal_index)
    &train := &sim.items[train_index]
    &signal := &sim.network.signals[signal_index]
    route_index := -1
    for: r < int(#sim.locking.routes)
        interlocking.Route route := sim.locking.routes[r]
        if route.start == signal_index and (route.state == "LOCKED" or route.state == "APPROACH")
            route_index = r
            break
    string route_name := if route_index < 0 then "-" else sim.locking.routes[route_index].name
    append_log(&sim, "PASS {train.name} {signal.name} {signal.aspect} {route_name}")
    signal.passes += 1
    train.passes += 1
    if route_index >= 0
        sim.locking.routes[route_index].state = "USED"
        sim.locking.routes[route_index].uses += 1
    details := ""
    if signal.aspect == "RED"
        append_log(&sim, "SPAD {train.name} {signal.name}")
        details = train.name + " " + signal.name
        train.emergency = true
    safety.check_property(&sim.safety_record, sim.tick, 3, details)

void move_train(Simulation &sim, int train_index, int distance)
    &train := &sim.items[train_index]
    current := head_section(train)
    remaining := distance
    while remaining > 0
        if train.boundary >= 0
            train.head += remaining
            break
        int end := current.start + sim.network.sections[current.section].length
        if train.head + remaining <= end
            train.head += remaining
            break
        remaining -= end - train.head
        train.head = end
        signal_index := layout.signal_at(sim.network, current.section, train.direction)
        if signal_index >= 0
            pass_signal(&sim, train_index, signal_index)
        if train.awaiting_departure >= 0 and train.stops[train.awaiting_departure].section == current.section
            append_log(&sim, "DEPART {train.name} {sim.network.sections[current.section].name}")
            train.stops[train.awaiting_departure].departure = sim.tick
            train.awaiting_departure = -1
        connection := layout.beyond_end(sim.network, current.section, train.direction)
        if connection.kind == "boundary"
            train.boundary = connection.index
            train.boundary_coordinate = end
        else
            current = trains.PathSection(connection.index, end)
            train.path = train.path.append(current)

void after_movement(Simulation &sim, int train_index, int speed, int previous_speed)
    &train := &sim.items[train_index]
    train.speed = speed
    train.distance += speed
    if speed > train.maximum_speed
        train.maximum_speed = speed
    if speed == 0
        train.emergency = false
    head := head_section(train)
    arrived := false
    if train.stop_index < int(#train.stops) and speed == 0
        trains.Stop stop := train.stops[train.stop_index]
        arrived = head.section == stop.section and train.head == head.start + sim.network.sections[head.section].length
    if arrived
        train.dwelling = true
        train.stops[train.stop_index].arrival = sim.tick
        append_log(&sim, "ARRIVE {train.name} {sim.network.sections[head.section].name}")
    if speed == 0 and not arrived
        train.standing += 1
        if previous_speed > 0
            append_log(&sim, "HOLD {train.name} {sim.network.sections[head.section].name}")
    if train.boundary >= 0 and train.head - train.length >= train.boundary_coordinate
        train.state = "EXITED"
        train.exited = sim.tick
        append_log(&sim, "EXIT {train.name} {sim.network.boundaries[train.boundary].name}")

void run_trains(Simulation &sim)
    distinct<int> entered_boundaries
    for: i < int(#sim.items)
        if not enter_train(&sim, i, &entered_boundaries)
            continue
        if not finish_dwell(&sim, i)
            continue
        distance := limit_distance(sim, sim.items[i])
        previous_speed := sim.items[i].speed
        speed := trains.select_speed(sim.items[i], distance)
        move_train(&sim, i, speed)
        after_movement(&sim, i, speed, previous_speed)

void recompute_occupancy(Simulation &sim)
    for: s < int(#sim.network.sections)
        sim.network.sections[s].occupants = []
    for: i < int(#sim.items)
        for part := occupied_parts(sim.network, sim.items[i])[]
            duplicate := false
            for occupant := sim.network.sections[part.section].occupants[]
                duplicate = duplicate or occupant == i
            if not duplicate
                sim.network.sections[part.section].occupants = sim.network.sections[part.section].occupants.append(i)

void sectional_release(Simulation &sim)
    for: r < int(#sim.locking.routes)
        &route := &sim.locking.routes[r]
        if route.state != "USED"
            continue
        int[] remaining := []
        for section := route.sections[]
            if sim.locking.route_locks[section] == r
                remaining = remaining.append(section)
                if layout.track_occupied(sim.network, section)
                    .route.passed.add(section)
        for section := remaining[]
            if not route.passed.has(section) or layout.track_occupied(sim.network, section)
                break
            interlocking.unlock_section(&sim.locking, sim.network, r, section)
            append_log(&sim, "RELEASE {route.name} {sim.network.sections[section].name}")
        all_unlocked := true
        for section := route.sections[]
            if sim.locking.route_locks[section] == r
                all_unlocked = false
        if all_unlocked
            interlocking.release_route(&sim.locking, sim.network, r)
            append_log(&sim, "DONE " + route.name)
        elif #route.overlap > 0 and route.overlap_locked
            int last := route.sections[-1]
            route.overlap_counter = if layout.track_occupied(sim.network, last) then route.overlap_counter + 1 else 0
            if route.overlap_counter >= sim.params.overlap_time
                interlocking.unlock_overlap(&sim.locking, sim.network, r)
                append_log(&sim, "OVERLAP " + route.name)

void record_statistics(Simulation &sim)
    for: r < int(#sim.locking.routes)
        if sim.locking.routes[r].state != "none"
            sim.locking.routes[r].locked_seconds += 1
    for: p < int(#sim.network.points)
        if #sim.locking.point_locks[p] > 0
            sim.network.points[p].locked_seconds += 1
        if sim.network.points[p].moving
            sim.network.points[p].moving_seconds += 1
    for: s < int(#sim.network.sections)
        if layout.track_occupied(sim.network, s)
            sim.network.sections[s].occupied_seconds += 1
        if sim.locking.route_locks[s] >= 0 or #sim.locking.overlap_locks[s] > 0
            sim.network.sections[s].locked_seconds += 1
        for occupant := sim.network.sections[s].occupants[]
            .sim.network.sections[s].trains.add(occupant)
    for: g < int(#sim.network.signals)
        string aspect := sim.network.signals[g].aspect
        index := if aspect == "RED" then 0 elif aspect == "YELLOW" then 1 else 2
        sim.network.signals[g].seconds[index] += 1

string trim_right(string text)
    stop := int(#text)
    while stop > 0 and text[stop - 1] == " "
        stop -= 1
    return text[0:<stop]

string[] build_diagram(Simulation sim)
    height := 0
    width := 0
    for section := sim.network.sections[]
        if section.row + 1 > height
            height = section.row + 1
        if section.last + 1 > width
            width = section.last + 1
    int[][] positions := []
    for point := sim.network.points[]
        positions = positions.append([point.row, point.column])
    for signal := sim.network.signals[]
        positions = positions.append([signal.row, signal.column])
    for buffer := sim.network.buffers[]
        positions = positions.append([buffer.row, buffer.column])
    for label := sim.network.labels[]
        positions = positions.append([label.row, label.column + int(#label.text) - 1])
    for position := positions[]
        if position[0] + 1 > height
            height = position[0] + 1
        if position[1] + 1 > width
            width = position[1] + 1
    string[][] grid := []
    for: row < height
        grid = grid.append(array(nat(width), fill = " "))
    for label := sim.network.labels[]
        for: offset < int(#label.text)
            grid[label.row][label.column + offset] = label.text[offset]
    for: s < int(#sim.network.sections)
        layout.Section section := sim.network.sections[s]
        character := if section.failed then "#" elif sim.locking.route_locks[s] >= 0 then "=" elif #sim.locking.overlap_locks[s] > 0 then "~" else "-"
        for: section.first <= column <= section.last
            grid[section.row][column] = character
    for train := sim.items[]
        for part := occupied_parts(sim.network, train)[]
            layout.Section section := sim.network.sections[part.section]
            length := section.length
            cells := section.last - section.first + 1
            left := if train.direction == "UP" then part.low - part.start else length - (part.high - part.start)
            right := if train.direction == "UP" then part.high - part.start else length - (part.low - part.start)
            for: cell < cells
                if left * cells < (cell + 1) * length and right * cells > cell * length
                    column := section.first + cell
                    previous := grid[section.row][column]
                    int code := previous.codepoints()[0]
                    grid[section.row][column] = if (code >= 97 and code <= 122) or previous == "*" then "*" else train.symbol
    for buffer := sim.network.buffers[]
        grid[buffer.row][buffer.column] = "|"
    for point := sim.network.points[]
        grid[point.row][point.column] = if not point.moving and not point.failed then point.position else "?"
    for signal := sim.network.signals[]
        grid[signal.row][signal.column] = if signal.aspect == "RED" then "X" elif signal.aspect == "YELLOW" then "Y" else "G"
    return [for row := grid[] then trim_right(row.join(""))]

string[] snapshot_lines(Simulation sim)
    string[] lines := ["SNAPSHOT {sim.tick}"].concat(build_diagram(sim))
    for train := sim.items[]
        if train.state == "RUNNING"
            string[] sections := [for part := occupied_parts(sim.network, train)[] then sim.network.sections[part.section].name]
            text := "TRAIN {train.symbol} {train.name} {train.direction} {train.speed}"
            if #sections > 0
                text += " " + sections.join(",")
            lines = lines.append(text)
    string[] routes := []
    for route := sim.locking.routes[]
        if route.state != "none"
            routes = routes.append(route.name + "/" + route.state)
    return lines.append("ROUTES " + (if #routes == 0 then "-" else routes.join(" ")))

Timing[] timing_rows(Simulation sim)
    Timing[] result := []
    for train := sim.items[]
        result = result.append(Timing(train.name, "enter:" + sim.network.boundaries[train.entry].name, train.entry_time, train.entered))
        for stop := train.stops[]
            string name := sim.network.sections[stop.section].name
            result = result.concat([Timing(train.name, "arr:" + name, stop.scheduled_arrival, stop.arrival), Timing(train.name, "dep:" + name, stop.scheduled_departure, stop.departure)])
        result = result.append(Timing(train.name, "exit:" + sim.network.boundaries[train.exit].name, train.scheduled_exit, train.exited))
    return result

string[] train_log_lines(Timing[] rows)
    lines := ["train,location,scheduled,actual,delay"]
    for row := rows[]
        timing := if row.actual < 0 then "-,-" else "{row.actual},{row.actual - row.scheduled}"
        lines = lines.append("{row.train_name},{row.location},{row.scheduled},{timing}")
    return lines

string punctuality_line(Timing[] rows)
    on_time := 0
    late := 0
    missing := 0
    total_delay := 0
    maximum := 0
    for row := rows[]
        if row.actual < 0
            missing += 1
            continue
        delay := row.actual - row.scheduled
        if delay <= 0
            on_time += 1
        else
            late += 1
            total_delay += delay
            if delay > maximum
                maximum = delay
    return "PUNCTUALITY on_time {on_time} late {late} missing {missing} total_delay {total_delay} max_delay {maximum}"

string[] summary_lines(Simulation sim, Timing[] rows)
    string[] lines := []
    grants := 0
    for route := sim.locking.routes[]
        string start := sim.network.signals[route.start].name
        lines = lines.append("ROUTE {route.name} {start}-{route.finish_name} requests {route.requests} grants {route.grants} uses {route.uses} cancels {route.cancels} wait {route.wait} maxwait {route.maxwait} locked {route.locked_seconds}")
        grants += route.grants
    for point := sim.network.points[]
        string final := if not point.moving and not point.failed then point.position else "?"
        lines = lines.append("POINT {point.name} throws {point.throws} locked {point.locked_seconds} moving {point.moving_seconds} final {final}")
    for section := sim.network.sections[]
        lines = lines.append("SECTION {section.name} occupied {section.occupied_seconds} locked {section.locked_seconds} trains {section.trains.size()}")
    for signal := sim.network.signals[]
        lines = lines.append("SIGNAL {signal.name} red {signal.seconds[0]} yellow {signal.seconds[1]} green {signal.seconds[2]} passes {signal.passes}")
    waiting := 0
    running := 0
    exited := 0
    for train := sim.items[]
        lines = lines.append("TRAIN {train.name} {train.symbol} {train.state} distance {train.distance} maxspeed {train.maximum_speed} standing {train.standing} passes {train.passes}")
        if train.state == "WAITING"
            waiting += 1
        elif train.state == "RUNNING"
            running += 1
        else
            exited += 1
    lines = lines.concat(["TRAINS total {#sim.items} exited {exited} running {running} waiting {waiting}", punctuality_line(rows), "REQUESTS total {sim.request_count} granted {grants} dropped {sim.dropped} pending {#sim.queue}"])
    return lines

void write_lines(string name, string[] lines)
    string content := if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(content)

void run_program()
    network := layout.read_layout()
    locking := interlocking.read_routes(network)
    plans := trains.read_plans(network, locking)
    sim := Simulation(network, locking, plans, read_parameters(), read_events())
    for: tick <= sim.params.end
        sim.tick = tick
        complete_throws(&sim)
        release_approaches(&sim)
        for request := sim.plans.requests[]
            if request.tick == tick
                add_request(&sim, request.route, sim.items[request.train].name)
        execute_events(&sim)
        judge_requests(&sim)
        decide_signals(&sim)
        run_trains(&sim)
        recompute_occupancy(&sim)
        sectional_release(&sim)
        safety.inspect_state(&sim.safety_record, tick, sim.network, sim.locking, sim.items)
        record_statistics(&sim)
        for snapshot_time := sim.params.snapshots[]
            if snapshot_time == tick
                sim.snapshots = sim.snapshots.concat(snapshot_lines(sim))
    bool directory_exists := file.is_directory("output")
    if not directory_exists
        file.mkdir("output")
    rows := timing_rows(sim)
    write_lines("events.txt", sim.log_lines)
    write_lines("snapshots.txt", sim.snapshots)
    write_lines("train_log.csv", train_log_lines(rows))
    write_lines("safety.txt", safety.report_lines(sim.safety_record))
    write_lines("summary.txt", summary_lines(sim, rows))

run_program()

import layout = "./layout.qui"
import interlocking = "./interlocking.qui"
import trains = "./trains.qui"

class Record()
    checks := [0, 0, 0, 0]
    violations := [0, 0, 0, 0]
    string[] lines := []

string[] property_names()
    return ["OCCUPANCY", "POINT_MOTION", "CONFLICT", "SIGNAL_PASSING"]

void check_property(Record &record, int tick, int property, details := "")
    record.checks[property] += 1
    if details != ""
        record.violations[property] += 1
        names := property_names()
        record.lines = record.lines.append("VIOLATION {tick} {names[property]} {details}")

void inspect_state(Record &record, int tick, layout.Network network, interlocking.State state, trains.Train[] items)
    for section := network.sections[]
        details := ""
        if #section.occupants >= 2
            details = section.name + " " + [for index := section.occupants[] then items[index].name].join(",")
        check_property(&record, tick, 0, details)
    for: p < int(#network.points)
        layout.Point point := network.points[p]
        if not point.moving
            continue
        details := ""
        if #network.sections[point.common].occupants > 0
            details = point.name + " occupied"
        else
            for held := state.point_locks[p][]
                string route_state := state.routes[held.route].state
                if route_state == "USED" or route_state == "APPROACH"
                    details = point.name + " locked"
        check_property(&record, tick, 1, details)
    for: first < int(#state.routes)
        string a := state.routes[first].state
        if a != "LOCKED" and a != "APPROACH"
            continue
        for: first + 1 <= second < int(#state.routes)
            string b := state.routes[second].state
            if b != "LOCKED" and b != "APPROACH"
                continue
            conflict := false
            for other := state.routes[first].conflicts[]
                conflict = conflict or other == second
            for other := state.routes[second].conflicts[]
                conflict = conflict or other == first
            string details := if conflict then state.routes[first].name + " " + state.routes[second].name else ""
            check_property(&record, tick, 2, details)

string[] report_lines(Record record)
    string[] result := []
    names := property_names()
    for: i < 4
        verdict := if record.violations[i] == 0 then "OK" else "FAIL"
        result = result.append("{names[i]} {verdict} checks {record.checks[i]} violations {record.violations[i]}")
    result = result.concat(record.lines)
    return result.append("RESULT " + (if #record.lines == 0 then "SAFE" else "UNSAFE"))

import layout = "./layout.qui"
import interlocking = "./interlocking.qui"

string[] decide_aspects(layout.Network network, interlocking.State state)
    cleared := array(#network.signals, fill = -1)
    for: r < int(#state.routes)
        interlocking.Route route := state.routes[r]
        if route.state != "LOCKED"
            continue
        valid := true
        for requirement := route.requirements[]
            layout.Point point := network.points[requirement.point]
            if point.moving or point.failed or point.position != requirement.position
                valid = false
        for section := route.sections.concat(route.overlap)[]
            if layout.track_occupied(network, section)
                valid = false
        if valid
            cleared[route.start] = r
    string[] result := []
    for: i < int(#network.signals)
        aspect := "RED"
        if cleared[i] >= 0
            interlocking.Route route := state.routes[cleared[i]]
            if route.finish_kind == "signal"
                aspect = if cleared[route.finish_index] >= 0 then "GREEN" else "YELLOW"
            elif route.finish_kind == "buffer"
                aspect = "YELLOW"
            else
                aspect = "GREEN"
        result = result.append(aspect)
    return result

import layout = "./layout.qui"
import interlocking = "./interlocking.qui"

class Stop(string kind, int section, int dwell, int scheduled_arrival, int scheduled_departure)
    arrival := -1
    departure := -1

class PathSection(int section, int start)
class BodyPart(int section, int start, int low, int high)
class PlannedRequest(int tick, int train, int route)

class Train(string name, string symbol, int length, int acceleration, int deceleration, int max_speed, int entry, int entry_time, int entry_speed)
    exit := -1
    scheduled_exit := 0
    Stop[] stops := []
    stop_index := 0
    state := "WAITING"
    direction := "UP"
    PathSection[] path := []
    head := 0
    speed := 0
    dwelling := false
    awaiting_departure := -1
    emergency := false
    boundary := -1
    boundary_coordinate := -1
    entered := -1
    exited := -1
    distance := 0
    maximum_speed := 0
    standing := 0
    passes := 0

class Plans(Train[] trains, PlannedRequest[] requests)

Plans read_plans(layout.Network network, interlocking.State state)
    Train[] items := []
    PlannedRequest[] requests := []
    map<string, int> ids
    symbols := "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    for row := layout.read_lines("trains.txt")[]
        fields := row.split(" ")
        if fields[0] == "TRAIN"
            index := int(#items)
            .ids.set(fields[1], index)
            items = items.append(Train(fields[1], symbols[index], int(fields[2]), int(fields[3]), int(fields[4]), int(fields[5]), layout.lookup_index(network.boundary_ids, fields[6]), int(fields[7]), int(fields[8])))
        else
            index := layout.lookup_index(ids, fields[1])
            if fields[0] == "REQUEST"
                requests = requests.append(PlannedRequest(int(fields[3]), index, layout.lookup_index(state.route_ids, fields[2])))
            elif fields[0] == "STOP" or fields[0] == "TURN"
                items[index].stops = items[index].stops.append(Stop(fields[0], layout.lookup_index(network.section_ids, fields[2]), int(fields[3]), int(fields[4]), int(fields[5])))
            else
                items[index].exit = layout.lookup_index(network.boundary_ids, fields[2])
                items[index].scheduled_exit = int(fields[3])
    return Plans(items, requests)

int braking_distance(int speed, int deceleration)
    count := speed / deceleration
    return count * speed - deceleration * count * (count + 1) / 2

int select_speed(Train train, int distance)
    low := train.speed - train.deceleration
    if low < 0
        low = 0
    if not train.emergency
        high := train.speed + train.acceleration
        if high > train.max_speed
            high = train.max_speed
        for: high >= speed >= low
            if distance < 0 or speed + braking_distance(speed, train.deceleration) <= distance
                return speed
    return low
